acceptance_criteria: `pub enum ExtrudeMode { NewSolid, Join, Cut, Intersect }` and `pub fn extrude_feature<K: Kernel>(k: &K, face: &K::Shape, extent: Extent, mode: ExtrudeMode, target: Option<&K::Shape>) -> Result<K::Shape, KernelError>`, documented. `NewSolid` returns the extrusion alone and ignores `target`.

Each test uses a target that is `make_box((0, 0, 0), (40, 25, 10))` and a profile on a workplane with origin (0, 0, 10) and normal +z: Join: a circle of radius 5 centered at (20, 12.5), `Distance(5)`. Volume 10000 + 125π ≈ 10392.6991. Cut: the same circle, `Distance(-10)`. Volume 10000 − 250π ≈ 9214.6018, face count 7. Intersect: a 10 × 10 square from (0, 0), `Distance(-4)`. Volume 400, bounding box (0, 0, 6)–(10, 10, 10). NewSolid: the circle with `Distance(5)`. Volume 125π ≈ 392.6991; the target is unchanged. Volumes within a relative 1e-6, boxes within 1e-6.

Errors, each with a test and never a panic: `Join`, `Cut` or `Intersect` with `target: None`; a `Cut` that removes the whole target (a 50 × 50 square from (−5, −5), `Distance(-10)`), or an `Intersect` with no overlap: the result volume is below 1e-9, which returns a new `KernelError` variant with a clear `Display` message.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M3-01b: Extrude result modes: new solid, join, cut, intersect against a target body
